whyItWorks.title: Why This Works
whyItWorks.text: The structured, broad shoulders of the golden blazer create an inverted triangle silhouette, balancing the slimmer cut of the tailored trousers below. This contrast between volume on top and precision below is a cornerstone of power dressing — elongating your frame and drawing the eye upward.
whyItWorks.calloutText: Broad shoulders taper to slim ankles — universally flattering. Creates visual height and an elongated, editorial proportion.

colors.name: Warm Gold
colors.desc: Adds richness & depth — complements warm skin undertones.

colors.name: Deep Charcoal
colors.desc: Grounds the palette — creates contrast & elongates legs.

tip.quote: "Try adding a delicate gold chain to break up the neckline of the blazer. A single fine chain at collarbone length will introduce jewelry as a counterpoint to the bold structure above."
